instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a sunny outdoor park with trees in the background, two friends stand close together on the grass. The man in the red sweater (R1) is positioned on the left in side profile, looking to the right and smiling. Facing him on the right, the man with long hair (R3) wearing an olive shirt and sunglasses smiles warmly. A cropped hand of an unseen bystander is visible on the far left edge of the frame. Bright natural daylight casts soft shadows across the scene, creating a warm and relaxed atmosphere.
